title: Prompt `arguments`
description: The declared arguments of a prompt, each with a name, description and required flag.
question: Does the argument contract of a prompt survive to the agent?
notes: The full argument contract, including which arguments are required, reaches both adapters that get to 2026-07-28; 3 cannot reach the revision.

notes_by_num.1: CrewAI 1.15.1 requires MCP Python SDK 1.26.x, so it cannot open a 2026-07-28 adapter session.
notes_by_num.2: LangChain MCP Adapters 0.3.2 requires mcp<2.0.0, so it cannot open a 2026-07-28 adapter session.
notes_by_num.3: Mastra 1.17.3 negotiated MCP 2025-11-25. The scanner refused to compare that capture with a 2026-07-28 source.

verdict.headline: The argument contract survives in both adapters that reach 2026-07-28.
verdict.detail: OpenAI Agents SDK 0.22.0 returns the arguments unmodified. Pydantic AI 2.40.0 maps them to `PromptArgument` objects retaining name, description and the `required` flag, so an agent can still tell a mandatory argument from an optional one. CrewAI, LangChain and Mastra cannot negotiate MCP 2026-07-28, so they reach none of it.

usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP servers using this capability. Not estimated, so the panel stays empty until the corpus is scanned.
why: Without the argument list a host cannot build a form, cannot validate before calling, and cannot offer completion. The prompt degrades from a parameterised template to a fixed string.
